## What's Changed
* Fix EMF resource packs not working on Forge, especially 1.20.1. Fix [#303](https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/issues/303) Fix [#290](https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/issues/290)
* Keep track of Resource loaded textures to not leak them. Related to [#23](https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/issues/23)
* Added ms_my.json by @Dreadmare in https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/pull/324
* Fixed existing Italian Localization file by @heytittino in https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/pull/325
* Update libs fixing leak issues in combination with Fabric API
* Update libs fixing a rare crash happening on Forge when loading many of my mods at once

## New Contributors
* @Dreadmare made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/pull/324
* @heytittino made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/pull/325

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/compare/1.11.3...1.11.4

releases.notes:
Hotfix release, turns out 3d Skin Layers did not have tests setup, letting a mixin issue from the Stonecutter conversion slip in.

## Hotfix changes
* Fixed game crashing for < 1.21.5
* Added tests to prevent this from happening again

## What's changed
* Add 1.21.11 Fabric/Neoforge support
* Fixed that Deadmau5 Ears break the layers
* Added option to enable/disable the Sodium workaround when using the Iris workaround (send help)
* Fix logic when EMF and Emotecraft is loaded
* Added new API for mods like Emotecraft to hook into
* Switched build system from Preprocessor to Stonecutter

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/3d-Skin-Layers/compare/1.9.2...1.10.1
